title: fix(doctor): clean up archive caches left by older versions
body:
Related: #193193. Follow-up to #193548. Thanks @SquareXRay for the report.

## What Problem This Solves

Old plaintext archive read caches remain indefinitely after upgrading past #193548, which removed both the cache writer and its age-based sweep.

## User Impact

`openclaw doctor --lint` reports leftover cache size without creating or repairing temp directories. `openclaw doctor --fix` removes recognized old cache files and their directory if empty; the normal update path already runs Doctor with repair enabled. Unrelated entries remain, and refused cleanup is reported without failing Doctor or update.

## Why This Change Was Made

The existing core Doctor/legacy-state contribution owns this one-time cleanup; read-only inspection reuses the temp-path owner with creation and permission repair disabled. It uses the preferred temp-directory resolver and refuses symlink or foreign-owned directories. Files must be regular files with the retired writer's name shape, including interrupted temporary writes. The reader-identity prefix remains unchanged.

Cleanup is best effort. Open POSIX handles remain usable after unlink; Windows may leave locked files for a later run. Native Windows behavior and a full package upgrade have not been exercised locally.

## Evidence

Exact-head CI and `openclaw/ci-gate` passed: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/42068202743.

ClawSweeper reviewed the exact head with no code findings; its remaining hold requests a latest-stable upgrade proof, which was not run in this macOS lane.

- The original core registration fails the new regression because the check is absent. A full baseline build and real isolated `doctor --fix --non-interactive` completed successfully while leaving the seeded cache file in place.
- 36 focused tests passed across the registered cache check, real temp-root ownership/permission behavior, legacy-state integration, and update Doctor policy (98.25 seconds including compiler/setup work; cache-check test bodies remain below 0.1 second).
- Scoped lint, core and relevant test type checks, formatting, and required ratchets passed. The first autoreview found temp-root writes during lint; the follow-up fixes that and adds real-filesystem coverage.
- Codex autoreview: scoped-clean through P2 on `4c1f81477cfb96fd989796adb1fee41f2574e6aa` against `bfbb6560585b1b7241a44a5202d927d093e776a8`. The final committed-head `pnpm build` passed (3m 30.8s). On macOS, the real isolated CLI reported the seeded 18-byte cache without deletion (3.53s), removed it and its empty directory with `doctor --fix --non-interactive` (25.85s, exit 0), and reported no cache on the following lint run (3.46s, exit 0). This exercises Doctor; no model inference was needed.

Production: +172 / -3 lines (net +169). Tests: +115 / -1 (net +114), covered by a separate 114-line allocation. The retired writer/sweep is already gone, so there is no remaining implementation to delete to offset the required cleanup and read-only path admission. No new store or user configuration option.
